main.description: Some media content: potentially video, audio, or subtitles. This record is intentionally minimal so that metadata can be altered without breaking strongRefs. For the stream's title and description and whatnot, check the `place.stream.video` with the tid matching this video.

duration.description: Total duration of the video in milliseconds.

source.description: The canonical source of this video, either some media tracks or a clip from another video.
